data.title: 胡桃 · 蝶引来生烈焰长枪
data.description: 【胡桃 · 蝶引来生烈焰长枪】炽热火光与阴阳符文交织的古战场上，护摩之杖通体迸发出灼热的赤红烈焰。胡桃压低重心单膝微蹲，双手紧握长枪破空挥斩，无数由纯净火元素凝结而成的火蝶在周身盘旋翻飞——「受命于天，既寿永昌！蝶引来生，火化九幽！」
data.action: 侧身压低重心单膝微蹲，双手紧握护摩之杖，周身火蝶飞舞烈焰升腾
data.lighting: 护摩之杖炽烈赤红火光与周身火蝶辉光
data.camera: full-body shot, dynamic low angle, both hands and full polearm visible
data.promptProse: Hu Tao settles into a low combat crouch on the cracked altar stones, both hands spaced firmly along the Staff of Homa. The polearm sweeps diagonally across the frame, leaving a thin red fire trail while small flame butterflies circle the shaft. Her director coat tails and red-tipped twintails follow the movement; her flower-shaped eyes stay fixed on the path of the strike. Use a low, wide view that includes her grounded feet, bent knees and the complete weapon. The staff’s red glow supplies the main light against the dim battlefield. No injured opponent or lettering.
